_comment: Unified causative schema, organized by DISPOSITION TIER. A 'causative' is any player action that acts on the companion. Each: 'delta' (disposition change, fractional — accumulates into 0..100), 'tier' (which disposition-gated tier it unlocks in), 'label' (button text), 'verb' (stage-direction sent to her when delivered by BUTTON), 'button' (does it appear as a player button; combat/inform/command fire from systems). Reactions live per-character in spec.json (her clip vocab). Tiers gate by disposition (see tier_thresholds); base is always available (apologize + negatives — you can always mend or damage). kiss/tickle are special (dedicated clips) and hardcoded in Tier 4. Cooldowns TBD (per-android personality). Two delivery paths: model classifies your chat, or a button delivers directly.

apologize.label: Apologize
apologize.verb: The Captain apologizes to you, sincerely.

boast.label: Boast
boast.verb: The Captain boasts arrogantly at you.

provoke.label: Provoke
provoke.verb: The Captain provokes you, trying to get under your skin.

chat.label: Small talk
chat.verb: The Captain makes easy small talk with you.

question.label: Ask
question.verb: The Captain asks you a light, friendly question.

appreciate.label: Appreciate
appreciate.verb: The Captain tells you how much they appreciate you.

joke.label: Joke
joke.verb: The Captain shares a joke with you.

story.label: Story
story.verb: The Captain tells you a story.

validate.label: Validate
validate.verb: The Captain validates how you feel.

comfort.label: Comfort
comfort.verb: The Captain comforts you, warm and sincere.

confide.label: Confide
confide.verb: The Captain confides something personal in you.

protect.label: Protect
protect.verb: The Captain shields you from harm.

inform.label: Inform
inform.verb: The Captain shares information with you.

command.label: Command
command.verb: The Captain gives you an order.
